author: Totally Not Mark
description:
Last week, I went back and gave The Legend of Korra a fair shot after dropping it as a teenager, and Book One left me… conflicted. I was NOT ready for what Book 2 had in store. The year is 2026, I've finished Book Two, and these are my thoughts! #avatarworld
